title: App won’t open recipes.
body: After whatever recent update (UI change) I haven’t been able to load any actual recipes. I can view the lists of available recipes, but actually navigating into a recipe to view the instructions and ingredients is no longer functional. It just hangs on the “so vegan” label. This needs a remedy considering I paid for my yearly.

title: App unusable
body: App would not function. Once I subscribed everything image shook spastically or froze. Tried deleting and re-downloading. Made no difference. Cancelled immediately.

title: App won’t let me sign up
body: App keeps telling me my email is already in use and won’t let me create a new account. Not sure why. Definitely needs to be fixed.

title: Would love to try but can’t sign in
body: I try to sign up; once I’ve entered in an email and password, the app says that email is already taken. So I try to reset my password, and I never get a reset email. I know that I haven’t signed up before, though. Would love it if y’all could work on that.

title: No free recipes
body: Downloaded the app and wanted to see a few recipes, only to find out that none of the ones I clicked on were free. For me, it is very important that recipes do not contain 100 ingredients. Since I was not able to glimpse the amount of ingredients on a single recipe, I deleted the app. You can't ask someone to pay for something they don't know. There have to be a few sample recipes, in order for a person to make a decision to pay for your app.

title: Can’t register
body: I just downloaded the app and tried to register as a first time user. When entering my email to make the account it says that the email is already in use. I’ve never used this app before.

title: Horrible on iPad
body: This is the absolute most frustrating app I’ve ever had the misfortune to deal with since I got my first tech device. Couldn’t sign in, so I tried to reset my password. You can’t choose or generate your own, you’re forced to take the weird 18 character gibberish they generate. Then when you try to use the new password to sign in, the keyboard never opens so you can’t sign in no matter how hard you pound on your touchscreen. Finally,the sign in screen goes black. Closing the app is useless, when you reopen it it’s still the black screen of death. I thought it’d be much easier to use this app to cook on my iPad than on a little phone screen but if I can’t even sign in to the app then what’s the point. Uninstall with great disappointment and much disgust. Great app on the phone but way too small. Enlarging the words only cuts off the important information like amounts and instructions. Maybe get the app up and running before putting it on the Apple store. Android version works perfectly on my Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra.

title: App stop working
body: This app logged me out, and wouldn’t allowed me to log back in. Also there isn’t a way to reset your password. Not cool.

title: Unable to print the recipe
body: You cannot get Wi-Fi inside grocery stores. Which means I cannot access the recipe for the grocery list which means I need to print it and the app will not allow you to print anything. Yes, you can export to another program for that ,but not for the recipe. If it is able to do it, and I am just not been able to figure it out please someone let me know how to and I will change my rating because other than this I like the recipes.

title: Diet filters don’t work
body: The filter feature for soy free doesn’t work. I have a soy allergy and three kids. I unfortunately don’t have time to read through every recipe to see if it’s soy free. I paid $19.99 for an app that I can’t use. The recipes look and sound amazing though.

title: Good recipes but crashes constantly.
body: The few recipes I have tried are great. The problem is that as I am scrolling to find new recipes the program either hangs or crashes which is super frustrating. I want to see more than the first 20 recipes. The program has some great features and if the could fix the crashing it would easily get 5 stars.

title: Tasty food in a great app!
body: I love this app and the people who make it are thoughtful and helpful. Made a suggestion for improving the meal planning portion and they are implementing it! The food is wonderful and I’m obsessed with many of the recipes already. Give it a try!!! You won’t be disappointed 🫶🌸

title: Love this app AND the recipes
body: I use this app for my weekly meal planning. The recipes are great and varied. The app functionality has gotten better over time. My only complaint would be that it takes me much longer to make the recipes than what they estimate. Aside from that, 10 out of 10

title: Scrumptious
body: Who doesn’t prefer scrumptious goodies!? Roxy and Ben put a lot of effort into their recipes. And they are delicious. I most recently made the brownies with black beans, avocado, dates, blackstrap molasses, chocolate, and other healthy ingredients. They were awesome! I highly recommend this app

title: Best app for yummy vegan cooking
body: Everything I’ve tried has been so good! Love that most recipes are pretty quick and easy and the flavors always delicious!

title: Simple but delicious
body: Awesome recipes

title: Variety and easy to use!
body: There are way more choices than I was expecting and I love how I can add items to a grocery list and quickly remove items. This will be my go to app for recipes moving forward!

title: Great, but I keep losing my place when
body: Really beautiful interface and so much better than using cooking blogs with all the glitchy adds! I just wish that the recipes would stay open when you leave the app. I keep losing my place when I leave the app for something. Is there anyway to fix this?

title: Best recipes ever!
body: Their recipes are by far the best I have ever cooked. I can’t tell you how much I love this app! There are also plenty of quick and simple meals. My only feedback is I wish they included chopping in the instructions instead of just the ingredients list. For example they will say two carrots chopped in the ingredients list but not tell you to chop when you are reading the instructions. The other is the measurements are in ounces instead of units of measure most people actually use like cups. This makes me have to guess a lot or do conversions and estimate.

title: Awesome app
body: A great and easy to use app with tons of delish vegan recipes!

title: Fabulous recipes!
body: Love these vegan recipes. Easy and delicious. I have not tried them all, but I’m working on it.

title: You’re doing amazing sweetie
body: Really blown away by the quality and diversity of all the recipes, not to mention how simple all these recipes are. Subscribing for life

title: Finally a vegan food app that I love
body: I did not have any issues with the app bugs that other users mentioned .. Signing up was smooth as peanut butter!! And the recipes are so versatile .. Being a software person myself, I could tell that this is a wonderfully done app with wonderful vegan recipes .. Yum 😋😋
